Auto start-stop can be switched off permanently by the driver

Proposal
1, implement. 45 complaint rows, all from ICE drivers (1.7 % of US complaints): the function cannot be disabled permanently, cuts in too early and feels harsh and unsafe at intersections.
Horizon
H1. Software setting and calibration, deliverable over the air.
Domain
Powertrain, Range & Charging
Markets
US
Evidence level
B (the best level of the primary and supporting findings)
Status
proposed, version 1
Reference
REQ-G60-US-PR-01 (the key of the decisions, the audit trail and the exports)

Statement

Drivers of ICE and mild-hybrid variants shall be able to switch auto start-stop off with one control and keep it off across drives in their profile; the restart shall not jolt the car.

Acceptance criteria

One row per market where expectations differ. Basis: evidence is a measured study value or a count; assumption is the agent's proposal for the product manager to set.

MarketMetricTargetHow measuredBasis
USStart-stop off setting kept after ignition offYes, per driver profileFunction testevidence
USStart-stop complaint rows<= 10 per 6 months (today 45)Customer feedbackassumption

    FND-G60-US-VOC-automatic_engine_start_stop_function_msa

    Customers of the BMW 5 Series Sedan (US) raise 45 complaint rows about 'Automatic engine start-stop function (MSA)' (2 defects, 32 usability problems, 11 wishes) from 3 source type(s); that is 1.7% of all complaint rows in this market and 96% of what customers say about this theme.

    Figures. 47 rows: 2 likes, 45 complaints (2 defects, 32 difficult to use, 11 wants). 1.7 % of the market's 2,625 complaint rows; 96% of the theme's rows are complaints. by powertrain: ICE 47. by source: Source B 23, Source A 17, Source C 7. by country: US 47.

    • Customer stated that when he is driving in Efficient Mode, he always switches off Auto Start/Stop but it still seems like the car is shutting off. Writer asked if he notices this with any of the other Driving Modes. Customer stated no, he sets it to Efficient Mode every time he drives. Writer asked how he is turning Auto Start/Stop off. Customer stated that when he gets in, he presses the MY Modes button, selects Efficient Mode on the screen, then swipes down from the right side of the display and taps the Auto Start/Stop icon in the upper right corner to disable it. Customer was very clear that he repeats this process every time he starts a trip. Writer asked if he could go out to the car, but customer stated he could not. Writer advised that on the Instrument Cluster there is a power gauge on the right side of the display, and when Auto Start/Stop is still active and he is stopped, it will show 0 or Ready. Customer confirmed this. Customer mentioned the dealership Genius had offered to come to his home for a tutorial. Writer advised that they would normally schedule an RVG session, but in this particular case it would likely work better for the Genius to sit in the car with him so he can feel it and see it together.

      G60-2642 · Source B · US · ICE · Defect, Automatic engine start-stop function (MSA), Malfunction · G60_feedback_hackathon.xlsx, row 3,336
